name: refuse-next-period
description: A next-period refusal names no party at all — time restores it. The envelope is otherwise identical, which is the point: the retry class is data on the wire, not a different shape.

refusal.message: the app reached the hard ceiling set for the current period
refusal.fix: the ceiling resets at the start of the next period; no action restores it sooner
